verdict.rationale: Extend has a broad programmatic surface: a REST API with authentication, SDKs, a CLI, and an MCP server. Every processing endpoint (extract, classify, split, parse, edit) works in sync and async modes, files can be uploaded for workflows, evaluation set items and parsing, and processors, evaluation set runs and versioned workflows are documented as API-level objects. Nothing states that the API matches the UI, though: Studio iteration, the Composer & Review Agent and human review routing are not shown to be available via the API. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of Studio, Composer, Review Agent and human review, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
